purpose: Independent style-slot reveal cues. These images are display-only candidates, not assembled components or finished Artwork and are not artistically approved for publication.
validationMethod: PNG IHDR/IDAT inspected with the Python standard-library PNG scanline decoder; sips confirmed alpha channel and pixel dimensions; shasum -a 256 recorded; each generated image visually inspected.
